acceptance.assertion: With otherwise healthy local checks, control-plane-poll-stale yields an unhealthy probe whose reason is control-plane-poll-stale; unavailable, missing or timestamp-invalid poll evidence alone remains indeterminate.
Concrete local health or readiness failures remain unhealthy and are never masked by control-plane metric uncertainty.
Repeated stale polls enter exactly the existing failure-threshold, restart-budget, backoff, jitter and recovery-probe path; no new restart subsystem or mutation authority is added.
Focused classification and restart-loop tests, full validation on supported Python versions, exact diff-bound self-review and required GitHub CI pass on one exact revision.

The reviewed merge revision is deployed through the canonical commit-bound path after live lease and deployment-contention checks; the tunnel timer is active and waiting with a future elapse, controlled stale-poll evidence reaches the existing restart path, connector snapshot and poll freshness renew, and a live Grabowski readback succeeds.
Evidence does not treat unavailable, missing or invalid metrics as restart authority and does not claim future transport availability, client compliance or permission to interrupt foreign work.

approval.note: GitHub issue #477 and the live host audit of 2026-07-26 define a bounded core correction. Reviewed implementation, tests, merge and exact-revision deployment are allowed; restart budgets, backoff and foreign work remain protected.

goal: Treat repeatedly stale control-plane poll evidence as an unhealthy tunnel condition that enters Grabowski's existing bounded restart loop, while unavailable, missing or timestamp-invalid poll evidence remains indeterminate and concrete local health or readiness failures retain precedence.

does_not_establish: authority to interrupt foreign work or release foreign leases

relation_to_timer_fix.scope: Independent scheduling fix already installed and verified on the host.

rollback.strategy: Revert the exact core-classification pull request and redeploy the immediately previous commit-bound Grabowski runtime. Keep the independently verified PR #478 calendar-timer scheduling unless it is separately shown faulty, and preserve audit, watchdog and connector receipts as append-only evidence.

title: Harden stale control-plane poll recovery
